section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Flat or simplified income tax regime for the self-employed
value: None: business income is taxed with the ordinary federal tariff (Art. 36 DBG) and the canton's tariff
note: The self-employed pay the whole AHV/IV/EO contribution themselves and family-allowance contributions to the cantonal fund; ALV and accident insurance are not compulsory for them.

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Permit for self-employed EU/EFTA nationals
value: B EU/EFTA residence permit, valid 5 years and renewable, on proof of genuine self-employment and sufficient means; cantonal migration office
note: The self-employed pay the whole AHV/IV/EO contribution themselves and family-allowance contributions to the cantonal fund; ALV and accident insurance are not compulsory for them.
source_title: SEM: FAQ EU/EFTA citizens in Switzerland (last modification 06.07.2026)

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: EU/EFTA self-employed permit: validity (years)
note: The self-employed pay the whole AHV/IV/EO contribution themselves and family-allowance contributions to the cantonal fund; ALV and accident insurance are not compulsory for them.
source_title: SEM: FAQ EU/EFTA citizens in Switzerland (last modification 06.07.2026)

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Self-employment for third-country nationals
value: Admission under Art. 19 FNIA only with a lasting positive impact on the Swiss labour market (business plan, market analysis, financial forecasts)
note: The self-employed pay the whole AHV/IV/EO contribution themselves and family-allowance contributions to the cantonal fund; ALV and accident insurance are not compulsory for them.
source_title: SEM: FAQ Work (non-EU/EFTA nationals) (last modification 05.07.2026)

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Digital-nomad or remote-work visa
value: None. EU/EFTA nationals working only for a foreign employer can be admitted as non-employed persons with sufficient means; for third-country nationals home-office work with an effect on the Swiss labour market needs a work permit
note: The self-employed pay the whole AHV/IV/EO contribution themselves and family-allowance contributions to the cantonal fund; ALV and accident insurance are not compulsory for them.
source_title: SEM Rundschreiben 'Tätigkeit im Home Office; ausländerrechtliche Qualifikation; FZA und Drittstaaten' (Bern-Wabern, 5. April 2022)

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Special tax regime for inbound workers (expats)
value: None in the tariff: the federal Expatriates Ordinance governs deductions for certain professional costs (applied by the cantons too)
note: The self-employed pay the whole AHV/IV/EO contribution themselves and family-allowance contributions to the cantonal fund; ALV and accident insurance are not compulsory for them.
source_title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Luzern (Stand: Februar 2026), Einkommenssteuer: Steuerberechnung, § 57 StG
